_comment: PARKED vendor-dialect constructs — NOT ISO (owner decision 2, ratified 2026-07-03; roadmap COMPLETION_ROADMAP_COUNCIL.md §5 #2): JSON/XML GENERATE/PARSE have ZERO hits in the entire ISO/IEC 1989:2023 spec (chair-verified; the former 'ISO 2014 §14.9.x' citations were fictional). Deferred post-G8; if built, they get a DIALECT axis (e.g. IBM Enterprise), never edition metadata in constructs.json. Sources preserved verbatim from the pre-scrub catalogue (DEVLOG 586).

constructs.description: JSON GENERATE — vendor extension (IBM Enterprise COBOL et al.); formerly mis-catalogued as 'ISO 2014 §14.9.x'

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. JG.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 G.
   05 A PIC X(3) VALUE "abc".
01 OUT-J PIC X(100).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    JSON GENERATE OUT-J FROM G.
    STOP RUN.
